jobs.title: Three drafts
jobs.prompt: a four-panel newspaper comic strip, four equal panels in a single horizontal row with thin black gutters (4 panels). Style: black and white comic strip panel, scratchy crow-quill pen and ballpoint ink on cardstock, harsh photocopy contrast, heavy black spotting, jagged uneven line weights, 1990s indie comix zine style, xerox grain, no color, no gray tones. Cast, drawn the same in every panel, ages exactly as given: WOOD — aged 20, thin young man with a slouch, three days' stubble, hair longer, brown canvas chore coat with a frayed cuff and one mismatched button, hands always in its pockets; BARNABY (the dog) — a low-slung terrier and hound mix, long body, short legs, folded velvet ears, wiry white-and-tan coat, gray on the muzzle from 2004, cloudy eyes from 2009, carried from 2010. Title of the strip: DRIFT WOOD. The strip: Thursday. The refusal to PNCA, drafted. Three drafts in the display face, each shorter. The third is one line. The dog sleeps on the first two. Panel 1: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, a young man at a small desk lettering a letter in bold hand-drawn display capitals, a small dog on the bed (in this panel: WOOD, BARNABY (the dog)). No dialogue in this panel. Panel 2: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, close-up of two crumpled letters on a bed with a small dog lying on them (in this panel: BARNABY (the dog)). No dialogue in this panel. Panel 3: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, close-up of a single hand-lettered line on white paper with a tiny gull mark beneath. No dialogue in this panel. Panel 4: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, a young man pinning a folded letter to a corkboard beside two envelopes, no words (in this panel: WOOD). No dialogue in this panel. Lettering: every balloon and caption contains its complete text exactly as written, in clean hand-lettered comic capitals, large enough to read; size each balloon to fit its whole sentence and never cut a word at a balloon or panel edge; no words other than the ones given. Bottom right margin: tiny signature "A. Finch — Small Wood, OR" beside a tiny stylized gull, two strokes. Reference @wood_20 is the model sheet for WOOD: match that face, build, hair and clothes exactly. Reference @barnaby is the model sheet for BARNABY (the dog): match that face, build, hair and clothes exactly. Reference @chloe_17 is the model sheet for CHLOE: match that face, build, hair and clothes exactly. Match the attached references: @wood_20 for the character Wood at 20-23; @barnaby for the character Barnaby; @chloe_17 for the character the strip's Chloe at 17.
